messages:
maya: Quick coordination Q — planning to turn up SDK v11 in staged capacity tomorrow. Who's owning the deploy window, smoke checklist, and rollback? Need a short runbook we can hand to oncall.

oliver: I can own the deploy. Suggest window 09:00-10:30 PST. Will do a canary then scale.

kira: I can draft the client-facing note and changelog snippet. Do we have a forced-compat header change or just new feature flags?

oliver: No header change — still X-Redwood-API-Version: v3. v11 is purely client SDK changes (serialization tweaks + optional batching flag). Should be backward-compatible but want to validate.

sam: For smoke: basic health, tokenized generation sanity, embeddings sanity, and an end-to-end sample from the mobile SDK. I'll own tests. Quick checklist:
- curl health on canary
- run e2e mobile sample
- run 10 qps for 2m to watch lat/p95

sam: curl example:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .status
```

sam: canary config (local):
```
cluster=canary-1
instances=2
traffic=5%
```

maya: nice. oliver can you post the deploy job link when scheduled? put rollback tag and who to page.

oliver: scheduling now. tagging infra and platform-oncall. rollback plan quick notes:
- abort rollout in k8s (kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-sdk)
- promote previous image: redwood/sdk:v10.4.2
- if config drift, toggle feature flag: sdk_v11_enable=false

platform-oncall: noted. We'll be available for the window. Page: #eng-oncall and my personal pager if it escalates. Keep alerts on latency and error-rate high buckets.

kira: for client comms: short bullet list + migration snippet. Draft: "SDK v11: minor serialization fixes, optional batching. No server API changes. Recommended: upgrade clients for perf; fallback to older client behavior via feature flag." I'll post in #announcements after deploy succeeds.

deploy-bot: Deploy job created: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/12345 (owner: oliver) — scheduled start 1872349200 (09:00 PST). Status: pending. :robot_face:

oliver: giving heads-up to SDK maintainers: @kira @sam please be by slack at start. I'll run the canary then pause for 15m to observe metrics. If green, proceed to gradual increase over 30m.

sam: I'll kick off the 10 qps load and monitor p95. Will post a short summary after 15m.

maya: thanks all. last ask: add a short rollback playbook to the deploy job description (steps you listed) so anyone can run it if needed. :thumbsup:

oliver: done — added playbook and rollback tags. See job link above. :shipit:

maya: perfect. i'll follow up with a tiny checklist in this thread tomorrow AM. :eyes:
